summary: Regex patterns duplicated across functions (bump-version.sh lines 47–49 vs 93–95; breaking_re, feat_re, fix_re should be module-level constants). JSON parsing via sed is fragile but acknowledged. Workflow follows GitHub Actions best practices (v4 pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, clear step IDs). Test harness is well-structured but hardcodes '1..25' test count, assuming bats suite size. No major bugs; production-ready with minor cleanup on duplication.
